text: Which of the following values could go in the blank to make this statement true: 11 x (blank/5) is greater than 11? Select the three correct answers from: 3, 7, 8, 4, 6, 5
answer: 7, 8, 6 (any value greater than 5 makes the fraction greater than 1, so the product exceeds 11)
skill: fractions - multiplying a whole number by a fraction greater than or less than 1

text: A number is shown: 15.837. Which of the following shows the number rounded to the nearest hundredth? A) 15.8 B) 15.9 C) 15.83 D) 15.84
skill: rounding decimals to the nearest hundredth

text: The value of the 4 in 62.43 is how many times the value of the 4 in 75.34? A) 1/10 B) 1/100 C) 10 D) 100
skill: place value - comparing the value of a digit in different positions

text: Which of the following shows three comparison statements that are all true? Option A: 2.150=2.15, 1.071<1.09, 5.714<5.8. Option B: 2.150=2.15, 1.071>1.09, 5.714<5.8. Option C: 2.150>2.15, 1.071>1.09, 5.714>5.8. Option D: 2.150<2.15, 1.071<1.09, 5.714>5.8
skill: comparing decimals to the thousandths place

text: A teacher wrote this expression to solve a math problem: 4 ÷ (1/12). Which of the following could be the problem being solved? A) An athlete runs 4 miles then walks 1/12 mile more, what's the total? B) A group shares 4 whole pies, each friend gets 1/12 of a pie, how many friends receive pie? C) A person works 4 hours total this weekend, works 1/12 hour Saturday, how many hours Sunday? D) A cook uses eggs in 4 recipes this week, uses 1/12 of a carton each recipe, how many cartons used this week?
skill: interpreting a whole-number-divided-by-fraction expression as a real-world problem
powers of ten - matching exponential form to standard number form

text: A number written in expanded form is shown: (2 x 100) + (5 x 1) + (1 x 1/10) + (7 x 1/100). Which of the following numbers in word form is equivalent? A) two hundred five and seven hundredths B) two hundred fifty and seven hundredths C) two hundred five and seventeen hundredths D) two hundred fifty and seventeen hundredths
skill: expanded form to word form, place value including decimals

text: Part A: Which of the following statements about rhombuses is true? A) All rhombuses are rectangles, but only some are squares B) All rhombuses are quadrilaterals, but only some are squares C) All rhombuses are squares, but only some are parallelograms D) All rhombuses are quadrilaterals, but only some are parallelograms
skill: geometry - hierarchy and classification of quadrilaterals (rhombus, square)

text: An expression is shown: (1 + 5) + 4 x (8 - 2) / 2. What is the value of the expression? A) 18 B) 21 C) 30 D) 39
skill: order of operations with parentheses, multiplication, and division

text: Which expression is equivalent to 7/8? A) 7 x 8 B) 7 ÷ 8 C) 8 + 7 D) 8 - 7
skill: interpreting a fraction as division of numerator by denominator

text: Find the quotient: 1.33 ÷ 7. A) 19 B) 1.9 C) 0.19 D) 0.019

text: Vivienne bought 6 packages of cheese for a party. Each package weighs 8 ounces. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the cheese Vivienne bought? (numeric answer, 16 oz = 1 lb)

text: One cup of trail mix contains 1/3 pound of dried fruit. Riley has 7 1/2 cups of the trail mix. What is the total amount, in pounds, of dried fruit in Riley's trail mix? A) 3 1/6 B) 2 1/2 C) 2 1/3 D) 1 1/6
